decisions.reason: As a 2023 line extension close to the core drainage range, it remains strategically fitting and sunk development and tooling costs make management more likely to continue than withdraw.
This shower channel is a core product with a dedicated presentation and strong fit to the firm's design-led drainage strategy, so visible commitment supports retention.
The tileable floor drain sits squarely in the established portfolio and its prominent market presence makes management inclined to justify and continue the launch.
The design grate reinforces the firm's aesthetics proposition and, although somewhat easier to prune than a full system, prior investment and portfolio fit still favor keeping it.

Even with the earlier withdrawal of Product C, this newly launched pump-drain channel has fresh investment and a public launch behind it, so management is likely to give it more time unless weakness quickly becomes unmistakable.
